description.value: A mixed-use RV and tent park on the Trans-Canada in Hope, within a 10-minute walk of Lake of the Woods and easy reach of Fraser Canyon trails; expect a trailer-park atmosphere with showers, laundry, and wifi alongside long-term residents.

address.value: 22885 Trans-Canada Hwy, Hope, BC V0X 1L3, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pinecliffresort.net is a third-party directory listing, not the business's own site (Pine Cliff Resort is based in June Lake, CA). The Cariboo Trailer Park page and guest reviews provide the primary evidence. Reviews by Katharine Wilson mention 'hot showers, wifi, laundromat available.' A review by Noreen Schaan reveals some residents live full-time, and the park is described as having 'spacious camping areas and RV sites' 3km from downtown Hope on the Trans-Canada Highway. Another review by 'bof En Mayor' notes washroom/shower reliability issues. No phone, cyclist-specific, or detailed amenity information is confirmable beyond what reviews state.
concerns: The URL is a third-party directory listing on pinecliffresort.net (a resort in June Lake, CA), not the business's own website; no direct website for Cariboo Trailer Park was found
Some residents live full-time at the park, suggesting it functions partly as a residential trailer park
Guest reviews report intermittent washroom and shower facility issues (blockages, showers temporarily down)
OSM has no address; address sourced from the third-party listing page only
Phone number from OSM could not be verified against any website content
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The park accepts short-term campers and is located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Hope, a key resupply and rest point for touring cyclists in the Fraser Canyon. Despite some residential character, it offers camping areas and basic amenities useful to cycle tourists.
